newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian PM says new IMF deal imminent.
newsitem.headline: Croatian PM says new IMF deal imminent.

text.p: Croatian Prime Minister Zlatko Matesa confirmed on Monday a new deal with the International Monetary Fund (IMF) on a three-year support programme was imminent.
"We are technically very close to an agreement with the Fund...and afterwards decisions have to be coordinated on the government and Fund level," Matesa told reporters.
An IMF mission arrived in Croatia recently to complete talks on an extended fund facility (EFF), which has been long in coming despite both sides saying there were no major obstacles.

The new loan facility of an as yet unspecified amount is to replace a previous 18-month stand-by arrangement, aimed at propping up the government's stabilisation efforts that expired in the spring. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
